title: ArkInv
body:
**Overview**
ArkInv is a lightweight and efficient plugin that allows administrators and moderators to **view**, **edit**, **give**, and **take items** from player inventories remotely, directly in-game.

Designed for PvP/Faction, Slyblock, OneBlock and Semi-RP servers, this plugin provides clean commands and fine-grained permissions for total and secure control over player inventories.

**Features**
✅ View a player's inventory in read-only mode
✅ Edit a player's inventory in real-time
✅ Add items to a player's inventory
✅ Remove items from a player's inventory
✅ Dynamically reload, unload, and load the plugin without restarting the server

**Commands**
/invsee <player>              → View a player’s inventory (read-only)
/invedit <player>             → Edit a player’s inventory
/invgive <player> <item> [amount]  → Give an item to a player
/invtake <player> <item> [amount]  → Remove an item from a player
/arkinvreload                 → Reload the plugin
/arkinvunload                 → Unload the plugin
/arkinvload                   → Load the plugin
Permissions
arkinv.see       → Use /invsee
arkinv.edit      → Use /invedit
arkinv.give      → Use /invgive
arkinv.take      → Use /invtake
arkinv.admin     → Use /arkinvreload, /arkinvunload, /arkinvload
**Installation**
1️⃣ Download the **ArkInv.jar** file
2️⃣ Drop it into your server’s /plugins/ folder
3️⃣ Restart or reload your server
4️⃣ Done!
